subject: Fix incorrect find/replace
reason: The change only corrects a mangled library filename (libhiENGINE_ssl.a -> libhiredis_ssl.a) in src/Makefile's BUILD_TLS=yes/module link flags. It is a build-system fix: with the bug, a TLS build fails to link; with the fix, it links. No runtime code, command reply, replication, persistence or config behaviour changes, so there is nothing for a scenario to exercise — the build either succeeds or does not.
